activity.notes: Collins was a leading Irish revolutionary and intelligence organizer during the War of Independence. ATLAS represents this pre-government revolutionary phase under the Irish political community Ireland rather than the United Kingdom, while preserving his separate 1922 Provisional Government of Ireland chairmanship as a distinct Activity.

sources.title: Michael Collins's intelligence war — National Library of Ireland catalogue
sources.citation_text: The National Library of Ireland catalogue identifies Collins as a revolutionary in Ireland and treats the 1919-1921 War of Independence as the core period of his intelligence-war activity.
